data.name: ZeroFactory
data.detailed_description:
Dive into the heart of survival and human ingenuity with Zero Factory, a unique survival game that blends magic and technology in an open world that is corrupted and constantly evolving.

🌍 Start your journey in the Stone Age and progress through the eras, unlocking technological advances to build massive automated factories and face the ultimate challenge: resource creation and management.

Customize your character 🔧

In Zero Factory, every stone, every blade of grass, and every drop of water can be the key to your survival. Manage your thirst and hunger, cultivate the land, raise livestock, and build shelters to protect yourself from the elements. But survival doesn’t stop there. Your world is alive and reactive, filled with secrets, dangers, and monsters drawn to mystical catalysts. These promise rewards while also posing deadly risks. Your ability to defend your domain and take advantage of these events can make the difference between prosperity and downfall.

Rebuild a village and welcome its residents 🏡

Help restore a forgotten village from its ruins and bring it back to life step by step. The more you rebuild, the more new residents will come to settle, each with their own trade and unique skills. The lumberjack will cut and store wood, the mechanic will improve your machines, while other NPCs will bring their own functionalities.

Little by little, you will shape a lively and functional village where each inhabitant contributes to your progression and to the prosperity of your world in Zero Factory.

Master the machine – The Age of Automated Industry

The beating heart of Zero Factory lies in its sophisticated and evolving machinery. As you progress, you will unlock and master a range of complex machines that will transform survival into a symphony of industrial efficiency.

Discover the machines ⚙️

  • Metal Furnaces: Transform raw ores into pure metal, laying the foundation for your technological rise.

  • Alloy Furnaces: Combine metals to create powerful and valuable alloys, essential for advanced structures.

  • Containers: Store massive amounts of resources to keep your factories running without interruption.

  • Assemblers: Unlock the true potential of automation by assigning them repetitive production tasks.

  • Automated Sawmills: Convert wood into essential components for every aspect of your setup.

  • Extraction Machines: Exploit the riches of the land without lifting a finger, fueling your progress toward industrial domination.

Each machine in Zero Factory is a step toward greatness. Your empire will expand not only across territory but also through the ages, transforming a wild and magical world into an automated industrial landscape — a testament to the power of human ingenuity.

Main Features

  • Dungeons, quests, and ancient mysteries: Embark on thrilling adventures in dungeons and complete quests to uncover the hidden story of Zero Factory.

    Rebuild and thrive: Restore a forgotten village and watch NPCs help you build a prosperous future.

    Flying machines: Build and customize airships to explore, trade, and transport goods.

    Mechanical wings: Soar through the skies with customizable wings powered by your machines.

    Monster farms: Create monster farms to generate gold, legendary equipment, and rare artifacts.

    Pets: Tame adorable companions like kittens to help you on your adventures.

    Survival and evolution: Start with nothing and progress technologically toward a fully automated era.

    Epic bosses and artifacts: Challenge colossal bosses guarding artifacts that enhance your industrial empire.

Zero Factory offers an unprecedented survival experience where every choice, every invention, and every battle shapes your destiny. Are you ready to take on the challenge?

English*, French, German
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080 / Radeon RX 5700
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080 / Radeon RX 5700
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
